name: Keysight Technologies
description: Keysight sells the test and measurement equipment and design software that engineers use to build and validate electronics: oscilloscopes, network analyzers, signal sources, simulation and test-automation software and test systems for 5G/6G, AI data-centre networking, aerospace and defense, automotive, energy and semiconductors. Customers pay for instruments (76 percent of revenue is products, mostly perpetual and term software plus hardware) and for services such as calibration, repair and support (24 percent). Demand follows customers' R&D and capital spending in communications and electronics rather than end-consumer demand; gross margin is 62.1 percent.

employees.note: Approximately 16,800 people worldwide, of whom 5,800 were in the Americas (5,500 in the US), 3,600 in Europe and 7,400 in Asia Pacific.

businessLines.name: Communications Solutions Group (CSG)
businessLines.how: Sells design-and-test software, instruments and systems to makers of wireless and wireline chips, devices, network gear and data-centre infrastructure, and to aerospace, defense and government labs: one-time instrument and licence sales to engineering teams, plus calibration, repair and support services.

businessLines.name: Electronic Industrial Solutions Group (EISG)
businessLines.how: Sells design, simulation and test software, instruments and engineering-simulation (computer-aided engineering) tools to automotive and energy, semiconductor and general-electronics customers, including universities and research labs: instruments and licences plus services.

brands.name: Spirent Communications plc
brands.note: Acquired 2025-10-15 for $1,415M net of $127M cash acquired; contributed only $9M of FY2025 revenue. Its high-speed ethernet, network security and channel emulation lines were sold to Viavi Solutions on 2025-10-16 for $399M to meet regulatory conditions.
